description: This file defines the 'CleanupCommand' interface, including constants, default method implementations, and a nested class 'JsonFields' that specifies JSON schema details for cleanup commands related to database maintenance activities such as journal entry cleanup.

classes.name: CleanupCommand
classes.description: An interface defining cleanup-related commands which extend a generic Command interface, providing default implementations and constants for command type and resource type specifications.

classes.name: JsonFields
classes.description: A nested class within CleanupCommand defining JSON field schema details specific to cleanup commands, particularly the 'entityId' field.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix string for cleanup commands, combining a static prefix with a qualifier.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string, fixed as 'cleanup'.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer indicating the resource path.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, set to MODIFY.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the entity ID associated with the cleanup operation.
